title: Traktor
description: A paint-like style and funny rp with some cool features, new ores, items and more cool stuff!
body:
![The Coolest rp to ever exist](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a32aabc91c5d02c607d80e2a1ccbb1daddbf187d.jpeg)

[![chat with us on discord](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f7ba56bdea313f30d12390daaabdd4d5e3893385.webp)](https://discord.gg/EAe3X7Dac9)

## what is traktor ?

**Traktor rp is a cool and funny rp, in the rp there is:**

>paint-like style ores and tools.

>funny environment.

>some QoL textures.

and more will come with new updates!

## found any issues ?

if you found any issues/bugs with the pack or want to give an amazing idea for the pack? [Join the LW Team discord server.](https://discord.gg/EAe3X7Dac9)

Thanks to ThatIsWirix for some help with the pack.
